players.product: AOI inspection and AOR laser-repair systems (plus VRS and in-line automation) for FC-BGA and other semiconductor package substrates

quarterly_data.signal: Correction filing for the semiconductor substrate inspection equipment supply contract signed 11-14-2025 with an undisclosed Japanese semiconductor substrate maker (no relationship to the company; a same-type contract performed with it in the last three years): export contract in yen, own production, 30% advance on PO receipt, 60% interim on delivery to the customer, 10% balance on customer acceptance. The contract end date (10-27-2026) is the date payment for the product is received, and as of the filing date payment had been received in full. At the customer's request to protect its trade secrets, the company continues the disclosure deferral, now until 10-27-2031 (was 10-27-2026), so only summary information will be disclosed after the contract end.
